title: Washer won't drain (mock result)
content: Most drain problems come from a clogged drain pump filter or a kinked drain hose. Unplug the washer, place a towel and shallow pan under the filter access panel, and drain the residual water before unscrewing the filter.

title: OE error on a front-load washer (mock result)
content: The OE code means the washer could not drain within the expected time. Check the drain hose for kinks, make sure the hose end is not pushed too far into the standpipe, and clean the drain pump filter.

title: Dryer not drying (mock result)
content: A restricted exhaust vent is the most common cause of long dry times. Clean the lint screen every load and check that the outside vent flap opens when the dryer runs.

title: E15 error on a dishwasher (mock result)
content: E15 indicates water in the base pan, which activates the anti-flood float. Turn off power and water, dry the base pan, and look for the source of the leak before restarting.

title: Refrigerator not cooling (mock result)
content: Confirm the temperature settings, make sure vents inside the fridge are not blocked by food, and clean the condenser coils if they are dusty.

title: Vacuum lost suction (mock result)
content: Empty the dust cup, wash the pre-motor filters with water only, let them dry completely, and check the hose and wand for clogs.
